scenario: Synthetic grant review: scoring fails, times out and succeeds; documents arrive; the verdict reads the FEEL clock; a cooling-off timer; the applicant is notified

models.content:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0. M-136 (decision 151) synthetic replay scenario: an external scoring task (retried
     after a failure and a lease timeout), a document message, a DMN verdict that reads the FEEL clock, a cooling-off
     timer, then a notification task (APPROVE) or a manual review (anything else). -->
<definitions xmlns="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
             xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
             xmlns:operaton="http://operaton.org/schema/1.0/bpmn"
             id="grantReviewDefinitions" targetNamespace="urn:sangam:replay:grant-review">
  <message id="documentsMessage" name="documentsReceived"/>
  <process id="grantReview" name="Grant review (synthetic)" isExecutable="true">
    <startEvent id="start"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="toScore" sourceRef="start" targetRef="score"/>
    <serviceTask id="score" name="Score the application" operaton:type="external" operaton:topic="replay.score">
      <!-- a read, safe to repeat: an expired lease re-offers the work (A-10 class a), so the scenario can time out -->
      <extensionElements>
        <operaton:properties><operaton:property name="sangam:capabilityClass" value="a"/></operaton:properties>
      </extensionElements>
    </serviceTask>
    <sequenceFlow id="toDocuments" sourceRef="score" targetRef="documents"/>
    <intermediateCatchEvent id="documents" name="Documents received">
      <messageEventDefinition messageRef="documentsMessage"/>
    </intermediateCatchEvent>
    <sequenceFlow id="toDecide" sourceRef="documents" targetRef="decide"/>
    <businessRuleTask id="decide" name="Verdict" operaton:decisionRef="grantVerdict" operaton:decisionRefBinding="deployment"
                      operaton:mapDecisionResult="singleEntry" operaton:resultVariable="verdict"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="toCooling" sourceRef="decide" targetRef="cooling"/>
    <intermediateCatchEvent id="cooling" name="Cooling-off period">
      <timerEventDefinition><timeDuration>PT1H</timeDuration></timerEventDefinition>
    </intermediateCatchEvent>
    <sequenceFlow id="toRoute" sourceRef="cooling" targetRef="route"/>
    <exclusiveGateway id="route"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="toNotify" sourceRef="route" targetRef="notify">
      <conditionExpression xsi:type="tFormalExpression">${verdict == 'APPROVE'}</conditionExpression>
    </sequenceFlow>
    <sequenceFlow id="toReview" sourceRef="route" targetRef="review">
      <conditionExpression xsi:type="tFormalExpression">${verdict != 'APPROVE'}</conditionExpression>
    </sequenceFlow>
    <serviceTask id="notify" name="Notify the applicant" operaton:type="external" operaton:topic="replay.notify"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="toApproved" sourceRef="notify" targetRef="approved"/>
    <endEvent id="approved"/>
    <userTask id="review" name="Manual review"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="toReviewed" sourceRef="review" targetRef="reviewed"/>
    <endEvent id="reviewed"/>
  </process>
</definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0. M-136 (decision 151) synthetic replay scenario: the verdict reads the FEEL clock
     (now()), so a replay must serve the recorded clock read. -->
<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="grantVerdictDefinitions" name="Grant verdict"
             namespace="urn:sangam:replay:grant-verdict">
  <decision id="grantVerdict" name="Grant verdict">
    <decisionTable id="grantVerdictTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="scoreInput" label="Score">
        <inputExpression id="scoreExpression" typeRef="number"><text>score</text></inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="termInput" label="Within the scheme term">
        <inputExpression id="termExpression" typeRef="boolean"><text>now() < date and time("2027-04-01T00:00:00@UTC")</text></inputExpression>
      </input>
      <output id="verdictOutput" name="verdict" typeRef="string"/>
      <rule id="approve">
        <inputEntry id="approveScore"><text>>= 600</text></inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="approveTerm"><text>true</text></inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="approveVerdict"><text>"APPROVE"</text></outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="refer">
        <inputEntry id="referScore"><text>-</text></inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="referTerm"><text>-</text></inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="referVerdict"><text>"REVIEW"</text></outputEntry>
      </rule>
    </decisionTable>
  </decision>
</definitions>
